units.title: Component 1 Section B: Post-1914 British play: An Inspector Calls (J.B. Priestley)

points.text: Know the whole play: plot, characters, setting and structure.
Explore themes such as responsibility, class, age and gender.
Relate the play to its contexts: written 1945, set 1912.
Write one essay from a choice of two, each opened by a short quotation.
Spelling, punctuation and grammar are assessed in this section (AO4, 8 marks).

units.title: Component 2 Section A: 19th-century novel: A Christmas Carol (Charles Dickens)

points.text: Know the whole novella: plot, characters, setting and structure.
Analyse language, form and structure in an extract of about 400 words (AO2).
Write an essay on the whole text: plot, setting, character or theme (AO1).
Understand Victorian contexts: poverty, the Poor Law, charity and redemption.

units.title: Component 2 Section B Part 1: Poetry Anthology, Conflict collection: poems 1 to 6

points.text: Study the first six poems of the Conflict collection in the Pearson Poetry Anthology.
Analyse language, form and structure in each poem.
Relate each poem to its context.
Compare a named poem with another poem from the collection.
Know the whole play: plot, characters, themes and structure.
Part (a): analyse language, form and structure in an extract of about 30 lines (AO2).
Part (b): explore how a theme from the extract appears elsewhere in the play (AO1, AO3).
Understand Jacobean contexts: kingship, the supernatural and James I.

units.title: Component 2 Section B Part 1: Poetry Anthology, Conflict collection: the remaining nine poems

points.text: Study the remaining nine poems, so all 15 poems of the collection are covered, as the specification requires.
Compare poems across the collection on theme and method.
Practise the comparison question against the mark scheme.

units.title: Component 2 Section B Part 2: Unseen poetry

points.text: Compare two unseen contemporary poems linked by a theme.
Analyse how each poet presents the theme through language, form and structure.
Build a timed method for reading and comparing unseen poems.

units.title: Year 11 revision: Macbeth, A Christmas Carol, An Inspector Calls and the Conflict collection

points.text: Autumn: revise Macbeth alongside Language Paper 1 and A Christmas Carol alongside Language Paper 2; November mocks.
Spring: revise An Inspector Calls; conflict and unseen poetry during Ramadan; second mock assessments.
Closed book: learn key quotations for every set text.
